title: ReliaPrep Viral TNA Miniprep System Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: User places binding column in water

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add Proteinase K to each tube in the odd columns of slot 2, up to the specified number of samples.

steps.title: Add Samples
steps.instruction: Add each patient sample to the same odd‑column tubes on slot 2, matching the number of samples.

steps.title: Add Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Add cell lysis buffer to the odd‑column tubes on slot 2.

steps.title: Incubate Lysis Mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes for 10 minutes; pause the protocol at the end of incubation and resume once the binding columns have been placed on the right side of the tube rack in slot 2.

steps.title: Add Isopropanol and Transfer
steps.instruction: Add isopropanol to the tubes, mix thoroughly, then transfer the entire contents from the odd columns to the right‑side tubes in slot 2.

steps.title: Centrifuge Transfer Mixture
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes as prompted to collect the transferred mixture.

steps.title: Wash Binding Column Three Times
steps.instruction: Repeat the following wash cycle three times: add wash solution to the binding column, centrifuge as prompted, and place an empty tube in each odd column of the tube rack on slot 2 between washes.

steps.title: Add Water to Odd Columns
steps.instruction: Add water to the odd columns of the tube rack on slot 2.

steps.title: Place Binding Column in Water
steps.instruction: Place the binding column into the water added in the previous step.

steps.title: Elute DNA with Water
steps.instruction: Add water to the binding column (and to the odd columns) to elute the DNA, forming the eluate.
